checks: Admin inspects the exact pending pair and full conditional tree
Required review reference and duplicate-click approval preserve one exact decision
Lost committed publication response preserves local modal and offers authoritative recovery without replay
Separate staff/applicant publications retain the exact approved pair
Audience filtering removes unsupported previews; retirement retains immutable history
Returned review shows recorded findings without presenting later editable content as the original
Admin resource routes complete their configured layout and accessibility checks
Scoped SCHOOL creation explains pending verification and preserves creator/verifier separation
Different authorized regional verifier activates the SCHOOL account through its representation
Newly verified synthetic SCHOOL account signs in without automatic eligibility grants
Native staff System theme control follows dark/light media preference with keyboard activation
Nationwide scope does not grant Super User questionnaire-review or reviewer-management permissions
Super User search and server pagination remain usable within explicit nationwide scope
Super User account-type and region selectors reflect explicit creation authority
Session loss leaves local noncredential input in the tab and offers sign-in/reopen guidance
